VO_01_INTRO.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_01_INTRO.subtitle_id: Unit Gagak-03, OCC Bekasi online. Sudirman padam total. Nyalakan generator stasiun, bersihkan gerbang tiket!
VO_01_INTRO.subtitle_en: Gagak-03, OCC Bekasi is online. Total Sudirman blackout. Power the station generator and clear the faregates!

VO_02_GEN_ON.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_02_GEN_ON.subtitle_id: Daya cadangan aktif! Lampu peron menyala. Awas, suara mesin memancing infected dari jalan raya!
VO_02_GEN_ON.subtitle_en: Aux power active! Platform lights on. Caution: engine noise is drawing infected from the boulevard!

VO_03_STREET_HINT.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_03_STREET_HINT.subtitle_id: Trotoar luar penuh perbekalan. Cek gerobak kopi dan kotak PLN jalanan sebelum naik ke peron.
VO_03_STREET_HINT.subtitle_en: Outer sidewalks have supplies. Check the coffee carts and street PLN boxes before heading up to the platform.

VO_04_CALL_HOLD.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_04_CALL_HOLD.subtitle_id: Rangkaian LRT darurat meluncur dari stabling. Bertahan di peron empat puluh lima detik!
VO_04_CALL_HOLD.subtitle_en: Emergency LRT consist en route from stabling. Hold the platform for forty-five seconds!

VO_05_TRAIN_DOCK.speaker: SYSTEM_ANN
VO_05_TRAIN_DOCK.subtitle_id: Stasiun Dukuh Atas BSI. Kereta evakuasi telah tiba di Peron Satu. Hati-hati celah peron.
VO_05_TRAIN_DOCK.subtitle_en: Dukuh Atas BSI Station. Evacuation train has arrived on Platform 1. Mind the platform gap.

VO_06_BOARD_WARN.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_06_BOARD_WARN.subtitle_id: Kereta sudah merapat! Masuk ke kabin sekarang sebelum kawanan infected menjebol pintu kaca!
VO_06_BOARD_WARN.subtitle_en: Train has docked! Get into the cabin now before the swarm breaches the window glass!

VO_07_CAWANG_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_07_CAWANG_ARR.subtitle_id: Stasiun Cawang! Sinyal mati, jalur terkunci. Ambil sekring bypass dari bangkai kereta di Jalur Empat!
VO_07_CAWANG_ARR.subtitle_en: Cawang Station! Dead signals, tracks locked. Retrieve the bypass fuse from the derelict cab on Track 4!

VO_08_FUSE_FOUND.speaker: PLAYER_G2
VO_08_FUSE_FOUND.subtitle_id: Sekring bypass didapat! Mengambil shotgun taktis dari bangkai masinis. Bergerak kembali ke Peron Satu.
VO_08_FUSE_FOUND.subtitle_en: Bypass fuse secured! Salvaged a tactical shotgun from the driver's wreck. Moving back to Platform 1.

VO_09_SPITTER_SEE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_09_SPITTER_SEE.subtitle_id: Awas, Spitter berjas hazmat di jembatan atas! Cari perlindungan dari semburan asamnya!
VO_09_SPITTER_SEE.subtitle_en: Watch out, hazmat Spitter on the skybridge! Take cover from its toxic acid spit!

VO_10_HARJA_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_10_HARJA_ARR.subtitle_id: Harjamukti gelap gulita! Nyalakan senter. Riset vaksin Dokter Rina ada di Kebun Atap Selatan!
VO_10_HARJA_ARR.subtitle_en: Harjamukti is pitch black! Use your flashlight. Dr. Rina's vaccine research is on the South Roof Garden!

VO_11_BRUTE_SEE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_11_BRUTE_SEE.subtitle_id: Awas Brute berlapis baja di depan! Incar kepalanya atau pancing ke drum merah!
VO_11_BRUTE_SEE.subtitle_en: Armored Brute ahead! Aim for the head or lure it into the red explosive drums!

VO_12_VAX_FOUND.speaker: PLAYER_G2
VO_12_VAX_FOUND.subtitle_id: Vaksin spora Dokter Rina berhasil diamankan. Menuju hanggar depo untuk buka jalur traksi utama.
VO_12_VAX_FOUND.subtitle_en: Dr. Rina's spore vaccine secured. Heading to the depot hangar to unlock the main traction line.

VO_13_SCREAM_WARN.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_13_SCREAM_WARN.subtitle_id: Awas Screamer! Tembak kista di lehernya sebelum dia menjerit memanggil seluruh kawanan!
VO_13_SCREAM_WARN.subtitle_en: Screamer alert! Shoot the neck cyst before it shrieks and summons the entire horde!

VO_14_HORN_HINT.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_14_HORN_HINT.subtitle_id: Tekan tombol klakson di kabin! Frekuensi suara LRT memecah fokus spora dan memancing mereka!
VO_14_HORN_HINT.subtitle_en: Use the horn switch in the cab! The LRT acoustic frequency disrupts spore focus and lures the horde!

VO_15_RETREAT_NOTE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_15_RETREAT_NOTE.subtitle_id: Amunisi menipis? Gunakan konsol Peron Dua untuk mundur dan isi ulang logistik!
VO_15_RETREAT_NOTE.subtitle_en: Running low on ammo? Use the Platform 2 console to backtrack and restock supplies!

VO_16_KUNING_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_16_KUNING_ARR.subtitle_id: Koridor Kuningan dilanda badai besar! Hati-hati peron licin, jalanan bawah banjir parah.
VO_16_KUNING_ARR.subtitle_en: Kuningan corridor is hit by a heavy storm! Watch your footing—the street below is flooded.

VO_17_CIKOKO_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_17_CIKOKO_ARR.subtitle_id: Stasiun Cikoko. Tangga transfer KRL penuh reruntuhan. Hancurkan barikade jalan tol untuk lanjut!
VO_17_CIKOKO_ARR.subtitle_en: Cikoko Station. KRL transfer stairs are choked with debris. Breach the highway barricade to push through!

VO_18_SETIA_ARR.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_18_SETIA_ARR.subtitle_id: Setiabudi! Garis akhir Kodam Jaya. Hubungkan tiga relai sinyal untuk buka gerbang evakuasi!
VO_18_SETIA_ARR.subtitle_en: Setiabudi! Kodam Jaya's final defense line. Connect all three signal relays to open the extraction gate!

VO_19_FINAL_WAVE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_19_FINAL_WAVE.subtitle_id: Gelombang merah datang dari segala arah! Bertahan sembilan puluh detik, helikopter evakuasi sudah di atas!
VO_19_FINAL_WAVE.subtitle_en: Red moon swarm incoming from all directions! Hold for ninety seconds—extraction chopper is overhead!

VO_20_COUNT_10.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_20_COUNT_10.subtitle_id: Sepuluh detik lagi! Masuk ke kabin masinis, bersiap terobos barikade terakhir!
VO_20_COUNT_10.subtitle_en: Ten seconds left! Get into the driver's cab and prepare to ram the final barrier!

VO_21_VICTORY.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_21_VICTORY.subtitle_id: Gerbang terbuka! Jalur aman. Kamu berhasil, Arya—vaksin dan data koridor selamat!
VO_21_VICTORY.subtitle_en: Blast doors open! Line clear. You made it, Arya—the vaccine and corridor data are safe!

VO_22_GAME_OVER.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
VO_22_GAME_OVER.subtitle_en: Gagak-03 is down! Vital signal lost.

VO_23_AMBIENT_CHIME.speaker: SYSTEM_ANN
VO_23_AMBIENT_CHIME.subtitle_id: LRT Jabodebek mengutamakan keselamatan. Tetap berada di belakang garis kuning.
VO_23_AMBIENT_CHIME.subtitle_en: LRT Jabodebek prioritizes safety. Please stand behind the yellow line.

VO_24_DOOR_CLOSE.speaker: SYSTEM_ANN
VO_24_DOOR_CLOSE.subtitle_id: Pintu kereta akan ditutup. Harap berhati-hati. Mind the closing doors.
VO_24_DOOR_CLOSE.subtitle_en: Train doors are closing. Please take care. Mind the closing doors.

TUT_01_WELCOME.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_01_WELCOME.subtitle_id: Gagak-03, ini Sarah di OCC Bekasi. Kita mulai latihan singkat. Coba bergerak maju dan periksa sekelilingmu.
TUT_01_WELCOME.subtitle_en: Gagak-03, this is Sarah at OCC Bekasi. Let's run a quick briefing. Move forward and check your surroundings.

TUT_02_INTERACT.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_02_INTERACT.subtitle_id: Bagus. Dekati gerbang tiket Access by KAI, lalu tekan E untuk membuka jalur dan memeriksa catatan di loket.
TUT_02_INTERACT.subtitle_en: Good. Approach the Access by KAI faregates and press E to open the lane and inspect the ticket booth logbook.

TUT_03_COMBAT.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_03_COMBAT.subtitle_id: Sekarang uji senjatamu. Tahan klik kanan untuk membidik, klik kiri untuk menembak tiga kali, lalu tekan R untuk isi ulang.
TUT_03_COMBAT.subtitle_en: Now test your weapon. Hold right-click to aim, left-click to fire three shots, then press R to reload.

TUT_04_INFECTED.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_04_INFECTED.subtitle_id: Dua infected mendekat! Incar kepala untuk daya rusak maksimal, atau tekan V untuk mendorong mereka mundur.
TUT_04_INFECTED.subtitle_en: Two infected approaching! Aim for the head for maximum damage, or press V to shove them back.

TUT_05_OBJECTIVE.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_05_OBJECTIVE.subtitle_id: Di tiap stasiun, kamu wajib menyelesaikan objektif utama dulu. Ikuti penanda menuju generator darurat dan tekan E.
TUT_05_OBJECTIVE.subtitle_en: At every station, you must complete the primary objective first. Follow the marker to the emergency generator and press E.

TUT_06_CALL_TRAIN.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_06_CALL_TRAIN.subtitle_id: Listrik menyala! Sekarang naik ke Peron Satu dan panggil kereta darurat.
TUT_06_CALL_TRAIN.subtitle_en: Power restored! Now head up to Platform 1 and summon the emergency train.

TUT_07_DEPART.speaker: OCC_DISPATCH
TUT_07_DEPART.subtitle_id: Kereta sudah merapat. Segera masuk ke kabin depan dan tutup pintu sebelum infected menyusul masuk. Semoga berhasil, Arya!
TUT_07_DEPART.subtitle_en: The train has docked. Step into the front cab and close the doors before infected follow you inside. Good luck, Arya!
